text:
sarah.peopleops: Heads-up team — candidate Park (Backend SWE) is coming onsite Thursday. Flight lands 09:20, interview window 11:00-15:30. Need: badge, parking pass, loaner Win laptop (or Mac if available), dietary note, arrival SMS.
sarah.peopleops: Quick ownership: jess 1 badge & parking, mike 1 loaner imaging + MDM, tom 1 arrival email + stipend, elena 1 panel backup.
tom.recruiter: Confirmed candidate prefers Windows. Requested quiet room for coding. Vegetarian + nut allergy. I have phone number ending in 3321.
mike.it: We have a loaner Dell with Win11 ready. Imaging with corp image requires ~12h; can do minimal image (browser + Zoom + vscode) in 4h. MDM enrollment automatic at first boot.
sarah.peopleops: Minimal image is fine. Please ensure disk encryption and local account. Also include our Wifi SSID and temporary password on the welcome slip.
mike.it: Will set Wi-Fi, install VPN client and company cert. ETA 4h. Will label device "Loaner - Park".
jess-ops: Parking: Visitor Lot C behind building. Gate code 3142#. I'll generate a QR and a small map. Badge pickup at 4th floor desk; show ID. I'll print the NDA and loaner agreement to sign.
elena.hiringmgr: Panel schedule: 11:00 intro, 11:30 take-home whiteboard (coding), 13:00 lunch with hiring manager, 14:00 system design, 15:00 wrap. If flight delayed, we can shift lunch and start remote for intro.
sarah.peopleops: @recruit-bot check flight status and set a 60-minute pre-arrival reminder for forms + badge.
recruit-bot: Flight AC235 arriving 09:20, status scheduled. Reminder set for 08:20 to prep badge/forms.
tom.recruiter: Drafting the arrival SMS/email now. Will include building address, parking code, host phone, and reimbursement link. Will not include interview content.
sarah.peopleops: Reimbursement: receipts to travel@redwood.com. Use Concur. Processing within 5 business days. Keep boarding pass + receipts.
mike.it: Note: loaner agreement requires candidate signature. Jess please have printed form and a pen. Also collect phone number for remote wipe consent.
jess-ops: Got it. I'll have forms, pen, and a sanitizer pack. Also will prepare a small GF snack box.
elena.hiringmgr: If we need remote option, we will run coding in Coderpad + Zoom. Tom, include backup Zoom link and host instructions.
tom.recruiter: Copy. I will cc panel leads on logistics only. Will paste final copy here after send.
sarah.peopleops: Thanks all. If anything changes (delay/cancel), update thread. I'll log the arrival email in candidate's file once Tom pastes it here. :thumbsup:
